responseText:
I can’t give exact revenue figures here. I don’t have the chart image, and even if I did, a chart with unlabeled gridlines and unlabeled bars doesn’t provide the underlying numeric scale needed to produce exact numbers.

If you need exact figures, one of these will get them fast:
- Attach the chart image (or the source file). I can then read/estimate values or point to next steps.
- Export the chart’s source data:
  - Excel/PowerPoint: right‑click the chart → Edit Data or Select Data → copy the table of values from the embedded worksheet.
  - Google Sheets: open the sheet that contains the chart and copy the data range used to build it.
- Ask the chart author for the original dataset or the y‑axis scale (e.g., “top gridline = $X”).

If you only have the chart image and need an estimate, tell me whether you can provide:
- the image, or
- at least one known numeric reference (for example “the top gridline is $100k” or “the tallest bar is $250k”).
With one known scale point I can estimate each month’s revenue from the bar heights (I’ll state the uncertainty with each estimate).
